vibe: Tactile, precise, structured drafting-board for serious writing. No 'SaaS slop' or 'AI magic' aesthetics. It is a tool for focused exploration.

fonts.heading: Antonio, sans-serif (Tight, uppercase or bold, authoritative)
fonts.mono: IBM Plex Mono (For Plotto codes in the backend/review ONLY, not for standard user choices)

rules.H1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter uppercase font-heading
rules.Anti-Pattern: NEVER center align paragraphs. Left-align for reading flow.

rules.contrast: Always ensure text meets APCA contrast standards. Do not use generic gray.
rules.accents: Use 'terra' (Emerald) exclusively for active states, the central 'Spine' line, and primary CTAs.
rules.backgrounds: NEVER use pure transparent backgrounds over content. Use bg-paper or bg-surface.

Left_Sidebar_Column_A.style: bg-surface border-r border-line-strong h-full overflow-y-auto thin-scroll p-6 flex flex-col gap-6
Left_Sidebar_Column_A.purpose: Contains the Primer Accordion and the Column A Progressive Disclosure Tree.

Main_Canvas.style: bg-paper drafting-grid relative h-full overflow-y-auto thin-scroll
Main_Canvas.purpose: The primary playground. Shows the 3-5 Plot-Point results, and transitions into the Stepping View (Parent/Child) timeline.

Review_Drawer.purpose: Process Steps compilation. Plain English translation of characters (A = Male Lead, etc.). No plotto codes visible to user except here in review.

PrimerPanel.style: bg-sage/10 border border-sage/30 rounded-sm p-2 mb-4
PrimerPanel.instructions: Collapsible intro explaining asterisks and character symbols (A, B, A-3, etc.). Keep it compact so it doesn't push the tree down too far.

DrillDownTree.interactions: Group -> Classification -> Masterplot. Only reveal the next level when the parent is clicked. Use Framer Motion 'AnimatePresence' for smooth downward expansion. Use staggered indentation (pl-4, pl-8) and a vertical connecting left-border line for child nodes.
DrillDownTree.visuals: Unselected nodes: text-ink-muted hover:bg-line/50. Selected nodes: text-terra font-semibold bg-terra/10 border-l-2 border-terra.

PlotPointResults.instructions: When a user drills down, populate this box in the Main Canvas with 3-5 matching Plot-Points. HIDE the reference numbers. Make them look like physical index cards.
PlotPointResults.style: bg-surface border border-line-strong rounded-sm shadow-sm hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-md hover:border-terra transition-all cursor-pointer p-6

SteppingView.spatial_metaphor: UP = Past (Parent), CENTER = Present (Selected Plot-Point), DOWN = Future (Child).
SteppingView.layout: A central vertical line (bg-line-strong or bg-terra/30) running top to bottom.
SteppingView.Center_Node: Large, bold card. bg-surface border-l-4 border-terra shadow-lg p-8.
SteppingView.Parent_Options: Rendered ABOVE center. Numbered 1..N (NO reference codes). Card style: bg-surface/80 hover:bg-surface border border-line-strong p-4 text-sm. Clicking prepends it to the story spine.
SteppingView.Child_Options: Rendered BELOW center. Numbered 1..N. Similar styling to Parent. Clicking appends it.
SteppingView.Character_Transform_Notes: Include plain English character change notes directly below the 1..N text in the option cards, in text-ink-muted.

ProcessStepsReview.trigger: Floating Action Button (FAB) or Header Button 'Review Process Steps' (Emerald Green).
ProcessStepsReview.content: Chronological list of chosen steps. Translate Plotto codes (e.g., A-5) to plain English (e.g., 'Male Lead\'s Friend'). Keep asterisks but explain them at the top. Include a 'Save Story' button for registered users.

motion.spine_expansion: When a Parent or Child is selected, use Framer Motion layout animations (layout prop) so the new node smoothly slides into the center position, and new options fan out above/below.
motion.list_stagger: When revealing the 3-5 Plot Points, use staggered fade-up (delay: index * 0.1s).
motion.micro_interactions: All interactive cards must have scale or Y-translate transitions (duration 0.2s ease).

visual_enhancers.background: Use the `.drafting-grid` CSS class (already in App.css) on the main canvas.
visual_enhancers.borders: Favor 1px crisp borders over soft shadows to maintain the 'writing tool/drafting' aesthetic. Nested radii rule: child radius <= parent radius.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA 4.5:1 minimum on backgrounds.
accessibility.data_testids: MANDATORY: Add data-testid to every clickable node, option card, and review button (e.g., data-testid='tree-node-group-1', data-testid='child-option-3', data-testid='review-steps-btn').
accessibility.keyboard: Ensure the progressive tree and timeline cards are fully navigable via Tab and Enter/Space.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use AI generated emoji icons. Use purely lucide-react icons (e.g., Book, ChevronRight, GitCommit).
CRITICAL: Hide Plotto reference numbers (e.g., '12a', '45b') from the user in the UI options. Replace them with ordinals (1, 2, 3...) when displaying Parent and Child options.
CRITICAL: Translate character codes (A, B, A-3) to their english meanings (Male Lead, Female Lead, Male Rival) in the Review drawer.
NEVER center-align paragraph text. Keep body text left-aligned.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for the custom 'SteppingView' layout, as Shadcn cards are too rigid for a branching timeline.
Utilize Framer Motion heavily for the spatial up/down transitions, as the 'fun, absorbed exploration' requires smooth context shifts.
DO NOT overcomplicate the layout with gradients. Rely on the flat 'terra' emerald green, 'paper' off-white, and sharp borders.
